identification: Five napkin rings: two with bright-cut engraved bands and beaded rims (one monogrammed), one plain band with bold cast/chased rims, one with heavy floral repousse rims and engraved name, and one with beaded rims and an applied Tasmania-map cartouche reading 'TASMANIA' (a 1910s-30s Tasmanian souvenir type, as made by Taylor & Sharp, Stokes, Golding, Sargison). Catalogue says sterling; no hallmarks visible in the single photo, weight not stated. Current bid A$40, estimate A$70-120.
